criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.header: Watching a hall with an Area Radiation Monitor
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_1: An Area Radiation Monitor hangs on a wall and reads the dose rate where it hangs, the same figure a Survey Meter held there gives
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_2: Its needle sweeps from 0.01 to 100 mSv/min, and it ticks like a Survey Meter, faster as the rate climbs
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_3: Set its alarm level on its value box. The first row is tenths up to 10 mSv/min, the second whole numbers up to 100
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_4: At or over that level its lamp lights and its horn sounds. It gives a redstone signal to the blocks around it and through the block it hangs on
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_5: It stays in alarm until the rate is a tenth under the level. Use it to silence the horn until the alarm clears
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_6: A comparator reads the rate against the alarm level
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_7: The Plant Linker remembers a monitor. A Dashboard Gauge shows its rate with the alarm level at the middle of the scale, and a Dashboard Alarm lamp lights while it alarms
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_8: A wall of Plant Screens linked to it graphs the rate, and a Display Link gives it as text
criticalmass.ponder.area_monitor.text_9: Shielding between the source and the monitor brings its reading down, as it does for you
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_1: Boron dissolved in the primary coolant holds the reaction down, 7 pcm for each ppm. It is the slow control beside the rods
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_10: Boron goes round the loop with the coolant. A leak takes it out, and coolant that boils off leaves it behind
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_2: A Dashboard Gauge bound to the controller reads it, and so does a Plant Screen
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_3: Crushed Scoria gives Borax, and Borax mixed with water in a heated basin gives Boric Acid. Keep it in a Fluid Tank
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_4: Run a Mechanical Pump from the tank to a spare inlet port on the vessel
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_5: The acid joins the coolant and its boron goes with it. 1,000 mB of acid into 6,000 mB of coolant leaves 1,000 ppm
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_6: Clean Primary Coolant pumped in the same way thins it out again. Another 1,000 mB brings it down to 875 ppm
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_7: Diluting a critical reactor adds reactivity as surely as pulling rods. Do it a little at a time and read the reactivity
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_8: A full vessel takes no more, so draw coolant off first. What is let down takes its share of the boron, and the reading stays where it was
criticalmass.ponder.boron.text_9: A Fluid Tank keeps the boron of the coolant in it. Pumped back in, it brings the same figure with it
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.header: Protecting a feeder with a Circuit Breaker
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_1: A Circuit Breaker has two terminals on top. The line side is ringed in brass and the load side in copper
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_2: Use it to close or open it. The red lamp is lit while it is closed and the green one while it is open
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_3: Its value box sets the current it trips at, from 0.1 to 6 kA. Set it at or under the limit of the wire it feeds
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_4: Above that current it trips, sooner the further above, and opens before the wire burns
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_5: A breaker tripped by its protection locks out. Use it once to reset it, and again to close it
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_6: A redstone signal trips it without locking it, and a comparator reads 15 while it is closed
criticalmass.ponder.breaker.text_7: A breaker protects only what is behind it, and can break a short circuit of up to 1,500 MW. Asked for more, it fails
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_1: The Reactor Controller trips the reactor by itself on fuel failure, high temperature, high flux, a short period and lost flow
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_2: A Dashboard Switch bound to the controller with the Plant Linker is a protection bypass
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_3: While it is on, none of those trips act. The reactor keeps running through what would have stopped it
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_4: A SCRAM by hand still works, and so does the trip for a broken vessel
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_5: An alarm lamp bound to the controller lights for it, and a Plant Screen lists BYPASS
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_6: Fit the switch with a glass cover, so it is not flipped by a stray hand
criticalmass.ponder.bypass.text_7: With the protection off a loss of cooling can go all the way to a meltdown. With it on, it cannot
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.header: Refuelling one column at a time
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_1: A Fuel Channel Cap takes the place of a casing block in the vessel's top, over a fuel column. It is that one column's way in and out
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_10: A fuel column shows the fuel it has left and its temperature: green in use, amber when spent or nearly so, red when damaged or too hot. A mark in its corner is a cap
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_11: A ring is a control rod and how far it is in. Beside the map the wall says whether fuel can move, and counts the caps still unlocked
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_2: Fit one over each column you mean to work on. A cap anywhere but over a fuel column is a vessel fault
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_3: Use a Wrench on a cap to unlock it, or hold it unlocked with a redstone signal. The reactor will not start while a cap is unlocked
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_4: With the reactor shut down, an empty hand lifts that column's assembly out, spent or not
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_5: An assembly used on the cap goes into its column. So part-burnt fuel can be moved from the middle of the core to the edge
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_6: The Service Port cannot do that. It gives up only the fuel that is spent
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_7: Funnels, Mechanical Arms and Deployers work a cap as hands do
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_8: An unlocked cap shields a quarter as well as casing. Lock every cap again when the fuel is where you want it
criticalmass.ponder.channel_cap.text_9: Use the Plant Linker on a cap or the Service Port, then on a wall of Plant Screens at least 3 wide and 2 high. The wall draws the core from above, north at the top
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_1: Chartrine lies in layered veins underground. It can also be grown, from lava and the Contaminated Coolant of a failed core
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_2: Leave a Fluid Pipe open a block above the lava and pump Contaminated Coolant to it. It leaves the pipe 1 mB a tick
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_3: About every 250 mB that lands on the lava turns it to stone
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_4: How contaminated the coolant is sets the stone. Straight from the core it is always Chartrine. Watered down by half it is Chartrine half the time and tuff the rest
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_5: Break the stone and let the lava flow back in for the next block
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_6: Only contamination the reactor made counts, and only while a record of it is kept. A Fluid Tank keeps it. Coolant carried in a bucket stays dangerous but makes only tuff
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_7: While stone fills the pit the coolant has no lava to land on. It dirties the floor instead, as any leak does
criticalmass.ponder.chartrine.text_8: Crushing Wheels turn Chartrine into Crushed Raw Uranium 12 times in 100
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.header: Cleaning the coolant with a Demineralizer
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_1: When a fuel assembly fails, the vessel's coolant becomes Contaminated Coolant. It keeps that as it goes round the loop and shares it with what it mixes with
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_10: A Used Resin Cartridge is radioactive, 12 mSv/min at one block when spent. Lift it out with an empty hand and put it in a Shielded Cask
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_11: Funnels and Mechanical Arms fit cartridges and take the spent ones. A comparator reads the resin left
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_2: A Demineralizer takes the contamination out of coolant and keeps it in a Resin Cartridge
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_3: One Mechanical Pump draws coolant off through a port and into it. A second returns what it has cleaned through a spare inlet port
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_4: Pipes join every face but the top
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_5: Use a Resin Cartridge on it to fit one. Contaminated coolant waits for resin. Clean coolant passes with or without it
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_6: It cleans 10 mB a tick, and the coolant's heat and its boron pass with it
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_7: Each pass takes out what goes through, so the loop gets cleaner as it turns over. At one part in a hundred it is Primary Coolant again
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_8: The window shows the resin bed: amber when fresh, part brown in use and brown when spent
criticalmass.ponder.cleanup.text_9: A cartridge takes up what 4,000 mB of wholly contaminated coolant holds. Then it is spent, and the line stops until it is changed
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_1: The Reactor Alloy Dashboard is a sloped desk. Desks side by side join into one run of up to 5, and each holds two parts
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_10: Sneak and use the wrench to take a part off again
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_11: Parts also mount on a floor, a wall or a ceiling, up to four to a block, and work the same there
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_12: The Plant Linker binds a part that is already fitted to another machine
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_13: Look at a part through goggles to see what it does and what it is bound to. A missing target shows in red
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_2: Sneak and use a part on a machine to bind it to that machine. Then use it on the half of a desk you want it in
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_3: A Dashboard Button on a Reactor Controller is SCRAM, reset, rods in, rods out, or raise or lower for the Power Regulator
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_4: A Dashboard Gauge binds to any plant machine and shows one of its readings on a needle. Use the gauge to see the number
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_5: A Dashboard Alarm is a caged lamp. A new alarm flashes it and sounds a klaxon until you press the lamp. It then stays lit until the fault clears
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_6: It watches a Reactor Controller, or a piece of electrical equipment such as a breaker, a motor or a transformer
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_7: A Dashboard Switch and a Dashboard Lever bind to a receiving Redstone Link, so they can work a clutch, a valve or a pump anywhere in the plant
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_8: The switch holds its link on or off. Hold use on the lever and move the mouse to set any strength from 0 to 15
criticalmass.ponder.control_desk.text_9: Use a Wrench on a part for its settings: its colours and style, a label, a glass cover, an indicator light, and what the part does
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.header: Rejecting heat: the cooling tower and the radiator
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_1: A cooling tower is built from the bottom. First comes a pipe to carry the cooled water away
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_10: A Radiator loses no water. Its pipes go on top and bottom, and it rejects heat through each of its four sides that is open to the air
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_2: Then up to 12 blocks of Cooling Tower Packing standing on that pipe. Stacked, they join into one glazed column
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_3: The hot water from the condenser goes into the side of the top block. It falls through the fill and leaves underneath
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_4: The water inside shows how full the whole stack is, and the stack reads as one tank
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_5: Open to the sky it draws by itself: 25%% of full airflow, and 5%% more for each extra block, up to 75%%
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_6: An Encased Fan on top adds 100%% at 64 RPM and needs no open sky. It has to blow the air up and out of the tower: reverse it if it blows down into the fill
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_7: A fan facing down is driven from above. One facing up is driven from below, through the vertical shaft that every fill block carries
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_8: Rejected heat evaporates water, 1 mB for every 2,000 HU. Pump make-up water into the side of the bottom block
criticalmass.ponder.cooling.text_9: The air leaving the top is as hot as the water. Above 50 °C it scalds anyone standing in it
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_1: A Centrifuge is an open steel frame with a brass drum that spins on the shaft. It takes its shaft from above or below
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_2: It only works at 96 RPM or more, and costs 8 SU for each RPM
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_3: Put Uranium Concentrate in by hand, funnel or hopper. A batch takes 2 and makes 1 Enriched Uranium and 1 Depleted Uranium
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_4: A batch takes 10 seconds at 128 RPM and 5 seconds at 256 RPM
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_5: Take the products out with an empty hand, a funnel or a hopper
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_6: Centrifuges stacked on one shaft are a cascade. Each one gets more Enriched Uranium from the same Concentrate for every other stage in the stack
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_7: Two stages give 1.25 from a batch, three give 1.5 and four give 1.75, with that much less Depleted Uranium. A fifth stage adds nothing
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_8: Each stage still has its own contents, so feed and empty every one
criticalmass.ponder.enrichment.text_9: Enriched Uranium goes on to become fuel pellets. Depleted Uranium mixes with gravel and water into Shielding Concrete
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_1: A nuclear explosion leaves a plume of fallout that the wind carries one way from the crater, hundreds of blocks long
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_2: In the plume the air itself gives a dose, up to 900 mSv a minute near the crater. It halves every 5 minutes
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_3: Fallout Ash settles across the plume for three minutes and kills the grass it lands on
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_4: The ash is contamination. It gives a dose until it is broken or washed off, and it does not decay
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_5: A roof overhead cuts the dose from the air to three tenths
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_6: A full protective outfit blocks most of the rest, since most of it is dust. A Survey Meter reads what is left
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_7: Break the ash to clear a way through. Flowing water washes it off, and a Mechanical Plough on a moving contraption sweeps it up
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_8: Ash cleared these ways is left as Fallout Ash. A Water Cannon washes it off everything within 24 blocks and leaves nothing
criticalmass.ponder.fallout.text_9: Animals and monsters caught in the open in the thick of it sicken and die
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_1: Condensate from the Condenser collects in a Create Fluid Tank set in the loop. That tank is the plant's reserve of feedwater
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_2: It needs the loop's two pipes on it, and the water in it keeps its temperature
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_3: A Threshold Switch on the tank reads how full it is. Lead its signal to the Clutch on a make-up pump, and the tank is topped up whenever it runs low
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_4: The feed pump is a Circulation Pump, and it has to be fed water
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_5: If what reaches it is boiling it cavitates: it loses the share of its flow that is steam, down to a tenth. Keep cooling water on the Condenser
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_6: An alarm lamp bound to a pump lights while it cavitates or stands still
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_7: A Heat Exchanger that the same loop crosses twice is a feedwater heater. The steam on its way to the Condenser passes through one side, and the feedwater through the other
criticalmass.ponder.feedwater.text_8: It warms the feedwater back up towards boiling, so less of the reactor's heat goes on heating water and more of it makes steam
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_1: A press over a heated Basin compacts each Enriched Uranium into a Ceramic Fuel Pellet
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_2: Reactor Alloy Sheets press into Fuel Cladding, two from each sheet
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_3: A Mechanical Crafter makes the Empty Fuel Assembly from 4 Reactor Alloy Sheets and a Sealing Gasket. Filling it is a sequenced assembly, on a Depot or a belt
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_5: Deployers add two Ceramic Fuel Pellets, one after the other
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_6: A Mechanical Press closes that layer
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_7: That is one of four layers. After four rounds it comes off as a Fuel Assembly, with 8 pellets and 4 cladding in it
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_8: The item's tooltip names the next step. Its progress stays on the item, so an interrupted assembly carries on later
criticalmass.ponder.fuel_assembly.text_9: A Fuel Assembly goes into the reactor through the Reactor Service Port
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.header: Holding coolant in a Fluid Tank
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.text_1: A Create Fluid Tank keeps the figures of the coolant or Boric Acid in it: its heat, its boron and its contamination
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.text_2: The figures go with the coolant through any pipe or pump, between tanks and the plant's machines, so a holding tank and a borated make-up tank work
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.text_3: Mixing shares them out. Coolant at one part contaminated in a hundred or less is Primary Coolant again
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.text_4: Use the Plant Linker on a tank to remember it for a Dashboard Gauge, a Plant Screen wall or a Display Link. They read its temperature, level, boron and contamination
criticalmass.ponder.holding_tank.text_5: A bucket, a Basin and an Item Drain keep no figures. Coolant from them comes cold and without boron, and Contaminated Coolant from them counts as wholly contaminated, with nothing on the reactor's record
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_1: A core is fuel columns with coolant channels and control rods beside them, inside a vessel of casing
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_10: The trips and the fuel's own feedback stop every accident short of this. It takes a protection bypass to get here
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_2: Above 800 °C fuel wears fast and the casing beside it cracks. The reactor trips at 1,100 °C, but decay heat keeps heating fuel that has no cooling
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_3: At 1,800 °C a fuel column melts. Its channel blocks become Ruined Fuel Channels and the molten fuel pools on the vessel floor as corium
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_4: Coolant in the vessel takes heat out of the corium, so keep the vessel flooded. An emergency injection line helps
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_5: Above 1,000 °C the corium eats the floor casing under it
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_6: When that block fails the corium leaves the vessel as hot Corium. It glows, burns, is a strong radiation source and contaminates the ground
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_7: It melts down through up to 3 solid blocks. Shielding Concrete and obsidian stop it, and water beside it cools it six times faster
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_8: Cooled, it is dark slag that can be mined. The slag and the ruined channels stay radioactive, as blocks and as items
criticalmass.ponder.meltdown.text_9: A core whose every fuel column has melted goes off as a nuclear explosion three seconds later
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.header: Showing the plant on Plant Screens
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_1: Plant Screens placed beside and above each other join into one wall
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_10: A linked wall that is too small says so on its face
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_2: A wall runs on rotation, like a Display Board. One turning Cogwheel beside any screen drives all of it, at 0.25 SU for each RPM and each screen
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_3: Use the Plant Linker on a machine to remember it, then on any screen of a wall at least 3 wide and 2 high
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_4: The wall shows the machine's name and state, trend graphs of its readings over the last two minutes, and a table of every reading
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_5: A bigger wall fits more graphs, up to six. Linking another machine to the wall replaces the first
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_6: A wall at least 9 wide and 5 high linked to a Reactor Controller shows the whole reactor: four trends, every reading, and a list of its trips and alarms
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_7: A wall at least 5 wide and 3 high linked to a Bus Bar draws everything wired to that bar as a one-line diagram, with a reading beside each part
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_8: An empty linker unlinks the wall. It then takes text from Create's Display Links like a Display Board, three lines and about five characters to a screen
criticalmass.ponder.plant_screen.text_9: A wall stays lit for up to 20 seconds after it stops turning, and a dark wall keeps its text for when the power returns
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_1: The primary loop carries the core's heat away: out of the outlet port, through the machines on the way and back in at the inlet port
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_10: Use a Dashboard Gauge on one of its sides to read the pressure
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_11: With the burner out the pressure falls back and hot coolant boils away, so a hot plant depends on that burner
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_12: The reactor will not start until coolant flows through the vessel, and it trips when the flow has stopped for 2 seconds
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_2: A Circulation Pump pushes coolant out of its front: 2 mB a tick for each RPM, up to 256 mB a tick. It stops when its shaft stops
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_3: A Heat Exchanger takes the primary through its front and back, and the secondary through its top and bottom. The two never mix
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_4: Heat crosses only while both sides are flowing. Exchangers stacked on one another work as one column of up to 8
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_5: A loop must be one path, with no branches
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_6: Plumb the loop with Create's Fluid Pipes, then use a Reactor Alloy Ingot on each one to reinforce it
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_7: A plain pipe leaks under pressure, and gives off radiation while it holds primary coolant
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_8: Vessel coolant boils at 350 °C and is lost as steam. A Pressurizer touching the vessel raises the pressure, and every bar adds 2 °C to the boiling point
criticalmass.ponder.primary_loop.text_9: Its heaters need a lit Blaze Burner directly underneath. Its value box sets the pressure, up to 150 bar
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_1: A Circulation Pump's seals wear while it moves coolant. They are worn out in 10 hours of running, and ten times as fast while the pump cavitates
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_2: From three quarters worn they leak coolant out beside the pump, up to 1 mB a tick, whether or not it is turning
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_3: Water is only lost. Primary coolant also contaminates the floor at the pump, so an Area Radiation Monitor in the pump room catches the leak
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_4: Goggles show the seals' condition and the leak. A Dashboard Alarm lamp bound to the pump lights while it leaks
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_5: Stop the pump and use a Sealing Gasket on it. Each one takes a quarter off the wear. A pump that is turning hurts the hand and takes no gasket
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_6: The floor stays contaminated until it is cleaned with Decontamination Compound
criticalmass.ponder.pump_seals.text_7: A pump keeps its wear when it is broken and placed again
criticalmass.ponder.reactor_vessel.text_: A reactor vessel is a box of Reactor Vessel Casing, odd on every side, from 5 by 5 by 5 up to 11 by 11 by 13
A Reactor Viewport takes the place of any casing block. Through it the fuel is dark when idle and glows blue at power
The controller's face shows the state: amber when shut down, green when running and red when tripped
With goggles on, the controller lists what is wrong or missing, and the blocks at fault are outlined in red
Inside stand columns of channels, one kind to a column. Fuel Channels hold the fuel assemblies
Coolant Channels carry the heat away
Control Channels take the control rods. Give every fuel column a coolant column and a control column beside it
Exactly one Reactor Controller sits in a side wall, facing out
A Primary Coolant Port set to outlet and one set to inlet go in the walls, facing out
A wrench switches a port between the two
A Reactor Service Port goes in the top, facing up. Fuel goes in and comes out through it
Only casing may sit on the edges and corners
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_1: A total meltdown guts a sealed building and leaves its shell standing. The work afterwards is in what the blast left inside
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_10: The site is read where the debris and the contamination landed and over the Corium. When every one of those reads under 1 mSv/min, it is cleared
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_11: Burying a source deep enough in Shielding Concrete counts as well as taking it away
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_2: Corium lies where it fell, hot and the strongest source on the site. Water beside it cools it six times faster
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_3: Cooled to slag it can be mined and stored behind shielding, or buried where it lies in Shielding Concrete
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_4: Pieces of the core are thrown outward until something stops them. Each piece of Core Debris gives 8 mSv/min at one block, lying there or carried
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_5: Take it up with a pickaxe and get it into a Shielded Cask, four to a cask. Bolted down, the cask lets 1%% of the dose out
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_6: About one in eight of the plant's blocks falls where it stood as Wreckage, so a vessel leaves a heap
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_7: Hold a Welding Torch on a piece for 2 seconds to cut it up. It gives back a Steel Plate, and sometimes nuggets or a Reactor Alloy Sheet
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_8: Most of the blast's contamination lands on the walls and floor that stopped it. A Survey Meter set to contamination finds the patches
criticalmass.ponder.recovery.text_9: Decontamination Compound cleans a patch three blocks across. It needs a tank within 4 blocks to take 250 mB of Contaminated Coolant as runoff
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_1: Fuel goes in and comes out through the Reactor Service Port in the vessel top. Its hatch is shut until it is turned open
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_2: Put a Valve Handle on top and use it to open the hatch. Sneak and use it to shut it again. A shaft from above does the same, by its direction
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_3: Use a Fuel Assembly on the open port to load a fuel column, and an empty hand to take one out. Funnels, hoppers and Mechanical Arms do both
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_4: A Spent Fuel Rack has four cells. Use an assembly on it to stand it in a cell
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_5: Spent fuel is hot and radioactive. Fill the rack with water by bucket or pipe: a flooded rack lets only a tenth of the dose out
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_6: A rack that runs dry lets its fuel heat up and wear. The water shows at its real level
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_7: Cooled assemblies and waste canisters go into a Shielded Cask. Use a wrench to unbolt its lid, and again to bolt it down
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_8: It takes and gives items only with the lid up, and a redstone signal holds the lid up for funnels and Mechanical Arms
criticalmass.ponder.refuelling.text_9: Bolted down it lets 1%% of the dose out. With the lid up it lets out half
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_1: A mistake costs equipment: too much voltage, a short circuit with no breaker to clear it, or lightning
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_2: Anything lost to a fault is left as a smoking wreck where it stood, with its wires gone
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_3: Use Copper Sheets and Steel Plates on it: 4 of each for a Transformer or a Generator section, and 2 of each for anything else
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_4: It stands again with its settings, unwired. String its wires once more
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_5: Broken instead, a wreck gives one Steel Plate
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_6: Motors, Transformers and breakers also wear. A Copper Sheet used on one, away from its value box, gives back a quarter of its condition
criticalmass.ponder.repair.text_7: It must be dead for that. Open its breaker, open a Disconnect Switch and close an Earthing Switch first
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_1: A Spent Fuel Assembly still holds uranium. It has to cool in a flooded Spent Fuel Rack before it can be taken apart
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_10: Contaminated Coolant gives a dose wherever it stands. Pipe it away and seal it in waste canisters
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_2: Shear it by passing it over a Mechanical Saw four times: along a row of four saws, or four times round on a belt
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_3: It comes off the fourth cut as 4 Sheared Spent Fuel
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_4: A saw leaves an assembly alone while it is still hot
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_5: A Mechanical Mixer over a heated Basin dissolves 4 Sheared Spent Fuel in 1,000 mB of water
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_6: It gives back 4 Uranium Concentrate and 1 Strontium-90, and leaves 400 mB of Contaminated Coolant
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_7: The concentrate goes to the Centrifuge again. It is a quarter of the uranium a new assembly takes
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_8: Two Strontium-90 make one Radioisotope Cell
criticalmass.ponder.reprocessing.text_9: The pieces give the dose the whole assembly gave, and so does every machine that holds them. Put the line behind Shielding Concrete
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.header: Working the rods from the control desk
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_1: This drive is in bank D, and its rod is fully in
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_10: Switch it off before moving bank D by lever, or the two fight
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_11: A trip drops the rods and switches the regulator off
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_2: A Dashboard Lever bound to the Reactor Controller is a rod lever. Its settings pick bank A, B, C, D or all of them
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_3: In the middle it holds the rods where they are
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_4: Pushed up it withdraws them and pulled down it inserts them. One notch off the middle moves them 0.6%% a second, and the end of its travel 4%% a second
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_5: Back in the middle, the rods stop where they are
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_6: The controller's face has a Power Regulator value box: Off, or a power from 1%% to 100%%
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_7: Or work it from the desk with two Dashboard Buttons. Raise switches the regulator on at the power the reactor is at
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_8: After that each press moves the setpoint 5%%. Lower takes it down, and switches it off below the last step. A gauge set to Regulator setpoint shows the figure
criticalmass.ponder.rod_control.text_9: While it is on, the controller moves bank D by itself to bring neutron power to the setpoint and hold it. It raises power no faster than a 20 second period and leaves the other banks alone
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_1: This vessel is shown with a wall open. A control rod fully in its column holds down the fuel columns beside it
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_2: A Control Rod Drive stands on the vessel top over a control column and moves that column's rod
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_3: It is turned by the cogwheel round its middle. Mesh a Cogwheel beside it, or set drives side by side and they turn each other
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_4: A redstone signal withdraws the rod, faster with shaft speed. The rod stands up out of the drive as it leaves the core
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_5: With the rods out the chain reaction grows, and the fuel glows blue
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_6: Rods will not withdraw until coolant is flowing through the vessel and the vessel is at least half full
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_7: Hold use on the drive's upper case to put it in a bank, A to D. A bank target set from the control desk moves every drive in the bank together
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_8: Losing shaft power, overstress or a trip lets go of the drive's latch, and the rod drops fully in within 2 seconds
criticalmass.ponder.rods.text_9: Fuel still gives decay heat after a trip: 7%% of its power at first, halving every minute. Keep the pumps running
criticalmass.ponder.siren.header: Warning of a meltdown with a Meltdown Siren
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_1: A Meltdown Siren stands on a floor
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_3: Use a Plant Linker on a Reactor Controller and then on the siren. The siren now watches that reactor
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_4: When the hottest fuel passes its trip temperature of 1,100 °C the siren starts to growl, and the note climbs as the fuel nears melting
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_5: Once fuel has melted or the vessel is breached it wails, rising and falling, and is heard 96 blocks away
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_6: Use it with an empty hand to silence it. A silenced warning stays quiet until the reactor is safe, but a meltdown sets it off again
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_7: With the danger past it coasts down, fast at first and then slowly, over about seventeen seconds
criticalmass.ponder.siren.text_8: A redstone signal sounds it at full cry too, whether it is linked or not, and that cannot be silenced by hand
criticalmass.ponder.standby.header: Standby power for the station bus
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_1: A Transfer Switch has three terminals: the normal supply and the standby one at its two ends, and the load in the middle
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_10: Batteries on the same wires share the load. Asked for more than they can give, they shut down for 5 seconds
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_11: The engine burns Fuel Oil from its own tank. A full tank lasts about 17 minutes flat out
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_2: A standby set is a Diesel Engine, a Generator and a Transformer down to 6 kV. The engine turns at 64 RPM, which is what a Generator needs
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_3: A Station Battery charges while the bus is live. With nothing else on its wires it holds the bus by itself, up to 2 MW
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_4: When the normal supply is lost, the battery carries the bus at once
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_5: A second later the switch lets go of the dead supply and gives a redstone signal. Lead it to the engine
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_6: The engine cranks for 3 seconds and runs
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_7: Once the standby supply is live the switch moves the load onto it, and the battery charges again
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_8: When the normal supply has been back for 5 seconds the switch moves the load back and drops the signal, and the engine stops
criticalmass.ponder.standby.text_9: It is never on both supplies at once, so the two need not be in step
criticalmass.ponder.steam.header: The steam loop, the turbine and the condenser
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_1: The secondary loop starts in the Heat Exchanger. Its water boils from 100 °C, and the steam runs from 1 bar up to 10 bar when it has all boiled
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_10: The blades wear while steam passes. Stop the turbine and use Turbine Blades on it: each one gives back a quarter
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_2: A Steam Turbine fills a three-block cube. Steam goes in at the back, the exhaust leaves through the bottom or the top, and the shaft comes out of the front
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_3: Its shaft is the plant's output: 4 SU for each HU/t of steam it takes. Its value box sets the speed, from 1 to 256 RPM
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_4: A governor follows the load on the shaft, so the turbine takes only the steam its load needs
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_5: Lose the whole load at once and the rotor overspeeds and trips. A full redstone signal, taken away again, resets it
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_6: A Condenser turns the exhaust back into water. Steam passes through it end to end and cooling water top to bottom, and it condenses only while the cooling water flows
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_7: A Circulation Pump sends the water back into the bottom of the exchanger, and the loop is closed
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_8: A Relief Valve fits inline. It vents through its front from 8 bar down to 6 bar, and gives a redstone signal while it vents
criticalmass.ponder.steam.text_9: Any pipe bursts when the steam in it passes 12 bar. Put a Relief Valve in every steam loop
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.header: Putting a Generator on the grid
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_1: The Grid Connection is live at 220 kV and 50 Hz. A Transformer brings it down to the generator's 20 kV
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_2: A Generator makes 50 Hz at 64 RPM. Off the grid its frequency follows its speed, and its speed trim moves it up to 1 Hz either way
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_3: With both sides live the breaker closes only when they are at the same voltage, within 0.2 Hz and within 20 degrees of each other
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_4: Closed out of step it refuses, and says which of the three stopped it
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_5: While the two frequencies differ the angle between them turns, one full turn a second for each hertz apart. A gauge bound to the breaker shows it
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_6: Raise and lower trim the generator by 0.02 Hz. Trim until the angle turns slowly
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_7: Close the breaker as the angle passes zero
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_8: On the grid the generator is held at 50 Hz and starts unloaded. Raise and lower now change its load, and its Load Setting value box sets it directly
criticalmass.ponder.synchronising.text_9: It takes at most nine tenths of what its shaft has to spare, so a weak turbine lowers the output and does not stall
criticalmass.ponder.tag.accidents.descri: What a reactor does when its protection is taken away, and what it leaves behind
criticalmass.ponder.tag.control.descript: Desks, screens and the parts on them that run the plant from one room
criticalmass.ponder.tag.electrics.descri: Equipment that carries the plant's power from the generators to the grid and back to its own motors
criticalmass.ponder.tag.fuel.description: Making fuel for the reactor, and what becomes of it when it comes out
criticalmass.ponder.tag.reactor.descript: The reactor, the loops that carry its heat and the steam plant that turns that heat into rotation
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.header: Taking a pipe through a containment wall
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.text_1: A pipe through a containment wall is a hole in it. Radiation gets out there, and so does the blast
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.text_2: Use a Wrench on the side of a Reinforced Pipe to lock it straight. A locked pipe joins nothing beside its run
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.text_3: Use Shielding Concrete on a straight or locked Reinforced Pipe to encase it. It becomes a full block with the pipe running through it
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.text_4: It shields like Shielding Concrete, stops corium and stands through a nuclear explosion, and coolant still passes along its one way
criticalmass.ponder.through_wall.text_5: A Wrench takes the casing off again, leaves a locked pipe and gives the concrete back. A bend or a tee cannot be encased
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.header: Heat Exchanger tubes that wear and leak
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_1: A Heat Exchanger's tubes wear while heat crosses them, faster the further apart the two sides are in temperature
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_10: Used on an exchanger that is hot or flowing, it burns you and takes no sheet
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_2: At 150 °C apart a block is worn out in 10 hours of running, and at 50 °C apart in 30. A taller stack spreads the heat and lasts longer
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_3: Hot coolant flowing through with the steam side dry wears them out in half an hour
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_4: From three quarters worn the tubes leak. Primary coolant crosses into the steam side, up to 4 mB a tick when they are worn out
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_5: The primary loop loses coolant and the steam loop gains it as water. Goggles on the exchanger show its condition and the leak
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_6: The leak carries activity round the steam loop, and every block and pipe it is in gives a dose. An Area Radiation Monitor in the turbine hall, set low, catches it
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_7: That activity halves every minute, so the dose is there only while the tubes leak
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_8: A Dashboard Alarm lamp bound to the exchanger lights while its tubes leak
criticalmass.ponder.tube_leak.text_9: To plug the tubes, stop both loops and let the exchanger cool to 60 °C, then use a Reactor Alloy Sheet on it. Each sheet takes a quarter off its wear
criticalmass.ponder.waste_canister.text_: Liquid waste is sealed into an Open Waste Canister by a sequenced assembly, on a Depot or a belt
A Spout fills it with 1,000 mB of Contaminated Coolant
A Deployer fits a Sealing Gasket
A Mechanical Press shuts it, and it comes off as a Sealed Waste Canister
A Damaged Fuel Assembly is canned the same way once it has cooled in a rack. A Deployer lowers an Open Waste Canister over it, another fits the gasket and a press shuts it
A half-sealed canister is as radioactive as what is in it. The Deployer leaves a hot assembly alone
A Sealed Waste Canister can be placed as a block. It is a radiation source where it stands, and a pickaxe takes it up again with its record kept
Canisters belong in a Shielded Cask, four to a cask. Bolted down it lets 1%% of their dose out
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.header: Washing down with a Water Cannon
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_1: A Water Cannon is a turret. A shaft from below turns its head
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_2: Water goes in by pipe on any side, or from a bucket. It holds 4,000 mB
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_3: After an explosion the ground is covered in Fallout Ash
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_4: While it turns it washes the ash off the top of everything within its reach, and puts out fire there
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_5: Its value box sets the reach, from 4 to 24 blocks. Each block washed takes 10 mB of water
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_6: Washed ash is gone and leaves nothing to collect. Clear ash by hand, with flowing water or with a Mechanical Plough to keep it
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_7: It also washes contamination off open ground and roofs, half of what is there at each pass. What lies under cover it cannot reach: that takes Decontamination Compound
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_8: With nothing left in reach it stops by itself and keeps its water
criticalmass.ponder.water_cannon.text_9: On a moving Sable body it washes the ground under where the body is now
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_1: Generators, Electric Motors, Transformers, Circuit Breakers, Bus Bars, Grid Connections and Insulators have terminals
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_10: Sneak and use a terminal to cut its last wire and get it back
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_11: Stringing or cutting a wire on a live terminal draws an arc. Open a breaker and work on the dead side
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_2: Use a wire on one terminal and then on another to string it between them
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_3: A wire reaches 24 blocks, and a terminal holds 4 wires
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_4: An Insulator stands on any solid face. It is a place to join wires, turn a corner or carry a run across a hall
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_5: Power Wire is copper, for 6 kV and 1 kA: enough for one motor at full load
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_6: Power Cable is thick and black, for 20 kV and 4 kA: it joins generators and feeds a motor bus
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_7: Transmission Line is bare and silver, for 220 kV and 1 kA: it carries power to the grid
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_8: A wire may be used below its voltage. Its current limit stays the same, so it carries less power there
criticalmass.ponder.wires.text_9: A wire above its current heats and glows orange. Left like that it burns through, and starts a fire at each end
block.criticalmass.area_radiation_monito: A fixed instrument that hangs on a wall and reads the _dose rate_ of a hall. Its _alarm level_ is set on its value box.
When the rate reaches its alarm level
Its lamp lights, a horn sounds and it gives a _redstone signal_ until the rate is a tenth under the level.
Silences the _horn_ until the alarm clears.
Goes under a _Fluid Tank_ used as a boiler and heats it with _hot coolant_ run through the sockets on its two ends.
Heats the boiler like a _kindled_ Blaze Burner, and at 200 °C like a _seething_ one.
item.criticalmass.borax.tooltip.summary: Crushed from Scoria. Mixed with water in a heated basin it makes _Boric Acid_, the plant's source of _boron_.
item.criticalmass.boric_acid_bucket.tool: A bucket of _Boric Acid_, whose boron holds reactivity down once it is pumped into the vessel. A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it.
The acid _spills_ and is lost, and the empty bucket comes back.
block.criticalmass.bus_bar.tooltip.summa: A copper bar where _feeders_ meet. Up to 8 in a line are one bar, and each block of it takes _4 wires_.
block.criticalmass.centrifuge.tooltip.su: Turns 2 Uranium Concentrate into 1 _Enriched Uranium_ and 1 Depleted Uranium. It takes its shaft from above or below and only works at _96 RPM_ or more.
block.criticalmass.centrifuge.tooltip.be: The stack is a _cascade_ of up to four stages, and each stage gets more _Enriched Uranium_ from the same Concentrate.
item.criticalmass.ceramic_fuel_pellet.to: _Enriched Uranium_ compacted in a heated basin. Deployers put pellets into an _Empty Fuel Assembly_ when a Fuel Assembly is made.
block.criticalmass.charred_log.tooltip.s: What a _nuclear explosion_ leaves of a tree trunk. It makes _Charred Planks_ and does not catch fire.
block.criticalmass.chartrine.tooltip.sum: A _uranium-bearing_ stone found in layered veins. Crushing Wheels turn it into _Crushed Raw Uranium_ 12 times in 100.
block.criticalmass.chartrine.tooltip.con: When Contaminated Coolant leaves an open Fluid Pipe over lava
block.criticalmass.chartrine.tooltip.beh: The lava turns to stone, which is _Chartrine_ as often as the coolant's contamination is on the _reactor's record_ and tuff the rest of the time.
block.criticalmass.circuit_breaker.toolt: Closes and opens a circuit, and trips on _overcurrent_ at the current set on its value box. Its _line side_ is ringed in brass and its load side in copper.
_Closes_ or _opens_ it, and resets one that its protection has locked out.
block.criticalmass.circulation_pump.tool: Drives a whole _coolant loop_ from its shaft and stops when the shaft stops. It pumps water, not steam, and its _seals_ wear while it moves coolant.
When a Sealing Gasket is used on it
Takes a _quarter_ off its seal wear if the pump is _stopped_, and on a turning pump it hurts you and takes no gasket.
block.criticalmass.condenser.tooltip.sum: Turns the turbine's exhaust _steam_ back into water, but only while _cooling water_ flows. Steam passes front to back and cooling water top to bottom.
block.criticalmass.condenser.tooltip.con: When set end to end along the steam side
block.criticalmass.condenser.tooltip.beh: Up to 8 Condensers work as _one row_.
item.criticalmass.contaminated_coolant_b: A bucket of _Contaminated Coolant_, which is _radioactive_ to carry. A Spout fills it and an Item Drain empties it, and coolant in a bucket loses the reactor's record.
The coolant _spills_ and is lost, the ground is _contaminated_ and the empty bucket comes back.
block.criticalmass.control_channel.toolt: Stacked into a column inside the vessel, it holds a _control rod_, which only controls the _fuel columns_ beside it. A Control Rod Drive on top moves the rod.
item.criticalmass.control_rod.tooltip.su: A rod that holds the _chain reaction_ down. It is crafted into a _Control Channel_.
block.criticalmass.control_rod_drive.too: Stands on the vessel's top face above a control column and moves that column's _rods_. It is turned by the _cogwheel_ round its middle and takes no shaft.
When it loses shaft power or the reactor trips
Its spring latch lets go and drives the rods _fully in_ within 2 seconds.
block.criticalmass.coolant_channel.toolt: Stacked into a column inside the vessel, it carries _coolant_ through the core. It cools the _fuel columns_ directly beside it, and only while coolant flows.
block.criticalmass.cooling_tower_packing: The fill of a _cooling tower_. Hot water falls through a stack of up to 12 and gives up its heat, and every block carries a _vertical shaft_ for a fan.
When an Encased Fan on top blows upwards
The _airflow_ rises and the tower needs no open sky.
block.criticalmass.core_debris.tooltip.s: A piece of the core thrown out by a _nuclear explosion_. It is more _radioactive_ than a spent assembly, lying there or carried, and a Shielded Cask takes four.
block.criticalmass.corium.tooltip.summar: Molten fuel that has left the vessel. Hot, it glows, _burns_ whoever stands on it and is a strong _radiation source_, and it cools to dark slag that can be mined.
An assembly whose fuel has failed. Once cooled in a _Spent Fuel Rack_, it is sealed into a _Sealed Waste Canister_ with an Open Waste Canister and a Sealing Gasket.
item.criticalmass.decontamination_compou: Cleans _contamination_. Each use puts 250 mB of Contaminated Coolant runoff into a _tank within 4 blocks_, and without such a tank nothing is cleaned.
When used on a contaminated area
block.criticalmass.deepslate_uranium_ore: _Uranium_ ore in deepslate. It gives a weak dose that harms no one, and a _Survey Meter_ ticks faster near a vein.
block.criticalmass.demineralizer.tooltip: Takes the _contamination_ out of coolant and keeps it in a _Resin Cartridge_. Coolant goes in on any pipe and comes out clean on any other.
When a Resin Cartridge is used on it
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
item.criticalmass.depleted_uranium.toolt: What the _Centrifuge_ leaves beside Enriched Uranium. Mixed with gravel and water it makes _Shielding Concrete_.
block.criticalmass.diesel_engine.tooltip: A rotation source for a _standby set_. It turns its shaft at _64 RPM_, the speed a Generator needs, and burns Fuel Oil from its own tank, filled by pipe.
It cranks for 3 seconds and then _runs_ while the signal lasts.
_Calls_ the engine by hand, and _releases_ it when used again.
block.criticalmass.disconnect_switch.too: A blade between two posts, for a _break you can see_. It has no protection and is worked dead, so open the _Circuit Breaker_ in line with it first.
It draws an _arc_, is lost and hurts whoever worked it.
item.criticalmass.dosimeter.tooltip.summ: Shows your _dose_ while it is held, and clicks with the dose its wearer takes.
item.criticalmass.dosimeter.tooltip.beha: _Resets_ its reading, though the lifetime dose stays.
block.criticalmass.earthing_switch.toolt: Ties its wires to _earth_. Close one on a dead line before working on it, and the breaker of anyone who then makes the line live _trips at once_.
block.criticalmass.electric_motor.toolti: Turns electricity back into _rotation_. It runs on _6 kV_ through the terminal box on top, and its speed is set on its value box.
item.criticalmass.empty_fuel_assembly.to: The frame of a Fuel Assembly. On a belt or depot, Deployers add _Fuel Cladding_ and _Ceramic Fuel Pellets_ and a Mechanical Press ends each of the four loops.
item.criticalmass.enriched_uranium.toolt: Made from Uranium Concentrate in a _Centrifuge_. Compacted in a heated basin it becomes a _Ceramic Fuel Pellet_.
item.criticalmass.fallout_ash.tooltip.su: What a cleared layer of fallout leaves. It is _weakly radioactive_, and it can be mixed into _Shielding Concrete_ or leached for Strontium-90.
Fuel for the reactor, one to each _fuel column_. It goes in through an open _Reactor Service Port_ or an unlocked Fuel Channel Cap.
When used on an unlocked Fuel Channel Cap
The assembly is _lowered_ into that column, if the reactor is shut down.
Stacked into a column inside the vessel, it holds the _fuel_. Every fuel column needs a _Coolant Channel_ and a Control Channel directly beside it.
block.criticalmass.fuel_channel_cap.tool: Takes the place of a casing block in the vessel's top face, over a fuel column, and gives that _one column_ its own way in and out while the reactor is shut down.
_Unlocks_ the cap or locks it again, and an unlocked cap keeps the reactor from starting.
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
Lifts the column's _assembly_ out, if the cap is unlocked.
Pressed from Reactor Alloy Sheets. Deployers fit it to an _Empty Fuel Assembly_ when a Fuel Assembly is made.
item.criticalmass.fuel_oil_bucket.toolti: A bucket of _Fuel Oil_, which a _Diesel Engine_ burns. A Spout fills it and an Item Drain empties it.
The oil _spills_ and is lost, and the empty bucket comes back.
block.criticalmass.generator.tooltip.sum: Turns rotation into _electricity_, at _50 Hz_ when it turns at 64 RPM. Up to 8 sections in a line on one shaft are one machine, and it is built for indoors.
block.criticalmass.grid_connection.toolt: The outside _grid_, at 220 kV and 50 Hz. It takes whatever is delivered to it and supplies whatever is drawn from it, and _power orders_ are set on its value box.
block.criticalmass.heat_exchanger.toolti: Passes heat between two loops that never mix. The primary goes through its _front and back_ and the secondary through its _top and bottom_, and its tubes wear with use.
When a Reactor Alloy Sheet is used on it
Takes a _quarter_ off its tube wear, but burns you unless both loops are stopped and both sides are at _60 °C_ or under.
block.criticalmass.insulator.tooltip.sum: Stands on any solid face. It is a place to _join wires_, turn a corner or carry a run across a hall.
block.criticalmass.meltdown_siren.toolti: A horn that stands on a floor or hangs on a wall. Linked to a Reactor Controller with a _Plant Linker_, it _growls_ as the fuel overheats and _wails_ once fuel has melted.
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
Sounds at _full cry_, linked or not, and cannot be silenced by hand.
block.criticalmass.open_waste_canister.t: Takes _Contaminated Coolant_ from a Spout, or a cooled _Damaged Fuel Assembly_. A Sealing Gasket and a press then shut it as a Sealed Waste Canister.
item.criticalmass.plant_linker.tooltip.s: The tool that _links_ a wall of Plant Screens or a Meltdown Siren to its machine, and re-binds a part already on a desk.
item.criticalmass.plant_linker.tooltip.b: _Remembers_ that machine, to be used next on a screen of the wall.
item.criticalmass.plant_linker.tooltip.c: When R-Clicked in the air while Sneaking
A screen with green text that runs on rotation. Screens beside and above each other join into one _wall_, which shows a _linked machine_ or Display Link text.
When a Plant Linker that remembers a machine is used on it
A wall at least 3 wide and 2 high shows that machine's _display_.
item.criticalmass.power_cable.tooltip.su: Thick black wire for _20 kV_ and _4 kA_, enough for four generator sections or to feed a motor bus.
item.criticalmass.power_cable.tooltip.co: When used on a terminal and then on another
item.criticalmass.power_cable.tooltip.be: _Strings_ the cable between them, up to _24 blocks_.
item.criticalmass.power_cable.tooltip.co: When R-Clicked in the air while Sneaking
item.criticalmass.power_cable.tooltip.be: _Lets go_ of a cable that has been started.
item.criticalmass.power_wire.tooltip.sum: Copper wire for _6 kV_ and _1 kA_, which is one motor at full load.
item.criticalmass.power_wire.tooltip.con: When used on a terminal and then on another
item.criticalmass.power_wire.tooltip.beh: _Strings_ the wire between them, up to _24 blocks_.
item.criticalmass.power_wire.tooltip.con: When R-Clicked in the air while Sneaking
item.criticalmass.power_wire.tooltip.beh: _Lets go_ of a wire that has been started.
block.criticalmass.pressurizer.tooltip.s: Raises the _primary pressure_ so that coolant can run hotter without boiling. It touches the vessel, is two blocks tall and needs a lit _Blaze Burner_ directly under it.
block.criticalmass.pressurizer.tooltip.c: When a Dashboard Gauge is used on its side
block.criticalmass.pressurizer.tooltip.b: The gauge is _fitted_ and its dial shows the _pressure_.
item.criticalmass.primary_coolant_bucket: A bucket of _Primary Coolant_, the coolant of the vessel and its loop. A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it.
The coolant _spills_ and is lost, the ground is dirtied and the empty bucket comes back.
Lets coolant into or out of the vessel. One set to _inlet_ and one set to _outlet_ go on the vessel's faces, facing outward.
item.criticalmass.protective_boots.toolt: The boots of the _protective outfit_. The outfit keeps _contamination_ off you, but it is not shielding.
Blocks a share of the _contamination_ you would take up and collects it itself.
item.criticalmass.protective_hood.toolti: The hood of the _protective outfit_. The outfit keeps _contamination_ off you, but it is not shielding.
Blocks a share of the _contamination_ you would take up and collects it itself.
item.criticalmass.protective_leggings.to: The leggings of the _protective outfit_. The outfit keeps _contamination_ off you, but it is not shielding.
Blocks a share of the _contamination_ you would take up and collects it itself.
item.criticalmass.protective_suit.toolti: The suit of the _protective outfit_. The outfit keeps _contamination_ off you, but it is not shielding.
Blocks a share of the _contamination_ you would take up and collects it itself.
block.criticalmass.radiator_panel.toolti: Rejects a cooling loop's heat through each of its four sides that is _open to air_. It takes its pipes on _top and bottom_.
When on a body moving through the air
Rejects up to _twice_ as much heat.
item.criticalmass.radioisotope_cell.tool: A sealed cell of Strontium-90 that gives no dose. Fitted to a _Station Battery_, it charges the battery with _no supply_ at all.
When used on a Station Battery
The cell is _fitted_, and a Wrench takes it out again.
item.criticalmass.raw_uranium.tooltip.su: _Uranium_ as it comes from the world, where the _fuel chain_ starts. A whole inventory of it gives less dose than the body recovers.
block.criticalmass.reactor_alloy_dashboa: A sloped _control desk_. Desks placed side by side join into one run of up to 5, and each holds _two parts_, one in each half.
item.criticalmass.reactor_alloy_ingot.to: The plant's alloy. It is pressed into Reactor Alloy Sheets and _reinforces_ pipes and valves where they stand.
When used on a Fluid Pipe or Fluid Valve
It becomes a _Reinforced Pipe_ or _Reinforced Valve_ and keeps its connections.
When used on a Glass Fluid Pipe
It becomes a _locked_ Reinforced Pipe along the same run.
item.criticalmass.reactor_alloy_sheet.to: Pressed from a Reactor Alloy Ingot. It goes into _Fuel Cladding_ and the Empty Fuel Assembly, and it plugs the tubes of a _Heat Exchanger_.
When used on a Heat Exchanger
Takes a _quarter_ off its tube wear, if both loops are stopped and both sides are at 60 °C or under.
block.criticalmass.reactor_controller.to: Exactly one sits on a side face of the vessel, facing outward. It shows the reactor's _state_, holds the vessel's coolant and carries the _Power Regulator_ on its face.
Outlines _invalid blocks_ in red and lists problems and missing parts.
Sets the rods of columns without a drive, from 0 for _fully in_ to 15 for _fully out_.
Goes on the vessel's top face, facing up. _Fuel_ goes in and comes out only while its _hatch_ is open, by hand, funnel, hopper or Mechanical Arm.
When a Valve Handle on top is used
The hatch _opens_, and sneak-using the handle _shuts_ it again.
block.criticalmass.reactor_signal_interf: Set in the vessel wall, it works the reactor by _redstone_ and offers its readings to _Display Links_. Hold use on its face to pick its job.
Acts once as it is set, with a _SCRAM_, a reset, rods in or rods out.
Gives a _redstone signal_ while any alarm is active.
block.criticalmass.reactor_vessel_casing: The wall of a reactor _vessel_, a box odd on every side from 5x5x5 up to 11x11x13. Casing beside overheating fuel _cracks_, and a Welding Torch repairs it.
block.criticalmass.reactor_viewport.tool: A _window_ that takes the place of a vessel casing block. It cracks, welds and shields like casing, and the _glow_ of the fuel channels shows through it.
block.criticalmass.reinforced_pipe.toolt: A pipe for coolant loops that neither _leaks_ under pressure nor gives off _radiation_. It takes Create's brackets like any straight pipe.
When R-Clicked on its side with a Wrench
_Locks_ it straight so that it joins nothing laid beside it, or frees a locked pipe again.
When Shielding Concrete is used on it
A straight or locked pipe becomes an _Encased Reinforced Pipe_, which can pass through a containment wall.
block.criticalmass.reinforced_valve.tool: A valve for coolant loops that does not _leak_ under pressure. While it is closed nothing _circulates_ in that loop.
Forwards _opens_ it and backwards _closes_ it, and a Valve Handle is the usual way to work it.
Fits inline in a steam loop and keeps its pipes from _bursting_. It senses the loop's peak pressure and vents through its front from _8 bar_ down to 6 bar.
item.criticalmass.resin_cartridge.toolti: The resin bed of a _Demineralizer_. It takes up what _4,000 mB_ of wholly contaminated coolant holds and is then spent.
block.criticalmass.ruined_channel.toolti: What a fuel channel becomes when its column _melts_. It stays _radioactive_, and the vessel is invalid until every one is replaced.
item.criticalmass.sealing_gasket.tooltip: Compacted from dried kelp and an iron nugget. It seals fuel frames, waste canisters and the protective outfit, and renews a pump's _seals_.
When used on a stopped Circulation Pump
Takes a _quarter_ off its seal wear.
item.criticalmass.sheared_fuel.tooltip.s: A cooled Spent Fuel Assembly cut up by _Mechanical Saws_, and radioactive. A heated Mixer dissolves 4 in water for Uranium Concentrate and _Strontium-90_.
block.criticalmass.shielded_cask.tooltip: _Dry storage_ for four cooled assemblies, waste canisters, Used Resin Cartridges or pieces of Core Debris. _Sealed_, it lets only 1% of the dose out.
_Unbolts_ the lid, which rises up its studs, or _bolts_ it down again.
Holds the _lid up_ for funnels and Mechanical Arms.
block.criticalmass.shielded_glass.toolti: A window that _shields_, though less than Shielding Concrete. A _nuclear explosion_ does not break it.
block.criticalmass.shielded_hatch.toolti: A hatch that _shields_ well while it is closed and hardly at all while it is open. A _nuclear explosion_ does not break it.
block.criticalmass.shielding_concrete.to: The plant's _shielding_. It cuts dose, stops _Corium_ and outlasts a nuclear explosion, sheltering what is behind it.
When used on a Reinforced Pipe
A straight or locked pipe becomes an _Encased Reinforced Pipe_, and the block of concrete is used up.
item.criticalmass.spent_fuel_assembly.to: A burnt-out assembly, _hot_ and strongly _radioactive_. Stand it in a flooded Spent Fuel Rack to cool, then keep it in a Shielded Cask or reprocess it.
block.criticalmass.spent_fuel_rack.toolt: An open steel tub with _four cells_, where spent fuel cools under _water_. Fill it with a bucket or a pipe, because in a rack that runs dry the fuel heats up and wears.
When an assembly is used on it
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
block.criticalmass.station_battery.toolt: A cabinet of cells for the _6 kV bus_. It charges while the bus is live and holds the bus up by itself, with up to _2 MW_, when everything else has gone.
When a Radioisotope Cell is used on it
The cell is _fitted_ and charges the battery with no supply at all, until a Wrench takes it out.
block.criticalmass.steam_turbine.tooltip: Turns steam into _rotation_. It fills a three-block cube, with steam in at the back, exhaust out of the bottom or the top and the _shaft_ out of the front.
When given a full Redstone signal
Shuts its _steam_ off and resets an _overspeed trip_, and a weaker signal limits the governor.
When Turbine Blades are used on it
Each one gives back a _quarter_ of its blades, if the turbine is stopped.
item.criticalmass.steel_plate.tooltip.su: Pressed from a Steel Ingot. Steel goes into the vessel casing and the shielded blocks, and a _Welding Torch_ uses a plate for each _weld_.
item.criticalmass.strontium_90.tooltip.s: Comes from reprocessing spent fuel and from leaching Fallout Ash. It is _radioactive_, and two of them go into a _Radioisotope Cell_.
block.criticalmass.surge_arrester.toolti: A post that leads a _lightning surge_ to earth. Wired to a line, it takes every strike on anything joined to that line at the same voltage, with _no damage_.
item.criticalmass.survey_meter.tooltip.s: Reads the _dose rate_ where you stand while it is held, and ticks like a Geiger counter, faster the more it reads.
item.criticalmass.survey_meter.tooltip.b: Switches to _contamination_, around you and on you.
block.criticalmass.transfer_switch.toolt: Moves a bus from its _normal supply_ to a _standby_ one by itself. Normal and standby are the terminals at the two ends, and the load is in the middle.
When the normal supply is lost
It lets go of it a second later and gives a _redstone signal_, which starts a _Diesel Engine_ it is led to.
block.criticalmass.transformer.tooltip.s: Joins two voltages, with a tall _high-voltage_ bushing and a short low-voltage one. Its _ratio_ is set on its value box, and it works both ways.
item.criticalmass.transmission_line.tool: Bare silver wire for _220 kV_ and _1 kA_, the voltage of the grid.
When used on a terminal and then on another
_Strings_ the line between them, up to _24 blocks_.
When R-Clicked in the air while Sneaking
_Lets go_ of a line that has been started.
A spare blade for the _Steam Turbine_, whose blades wear while steam passes.
When used on a stopped Steam Turbine
Gives back a _quarter_ of its blades.
item.criticalmass.uranium_concentrate.to: The feed of the _Centrifuge_, which turns 2 into 1 _Enriched Uranium_ and 1 Depleted Uranium. Reprocessing spent fuel gives some back.
block.criticalmass.uranium_ore.tooltip.s: Stone that holds _uranium_. It gives a weak dose that harms no one, and a _Survey Meter_ ticks faster near a vein.
item.criticalmass.used_resin_cartridge.t: A Resin Cartridge that has taken up contamination and is _radioactive_. One that still has resin goes back in, and a spent one goes into a _Shielded Cask_.
A turret that washes _Fallout Ash_, fire and _contamination_ off everything round it. It takes a shaft from below and water by pipe or from a bucket.
When turned by a shaft from below
Its head turns with the shaft and it washes everything within its _reach_, which is set on its value board.
Welds cracked _vessel casing_ and cuts up _Wreckage_.
When held on cracked casing for 2 seconds
Restores _50%_ of its integrity and uses a _Steel Plate_ from your inventory.
When held on Wreckage for 2 seconds
Cuts it into _scrap_ and uses no plate.
block.criticalmass.wreckage.tooltip.summ: What a _nuclear explosion_ leaves of the plant's blocks. A pickaxe clears it and saves nothing.
block.criticalmass.wreckage.tooltip.cond: When a Welding Torch is held on it for 2 seconds
block.criticalmass.wreckage.tooltip.beha: Cuts it up for a _Steel Plate_, sometimes Steel Nuggets and now and then a Reactor Alloy Sheet.
item.criticalmass.dashboard_button.toolt: A push button for a _Reactor Alloy Dashboard_. It works a Reactor Controller, a Steam Turbine, a Generator, a Circuit Breaker or a receiving _Redstone Link_.
When R-Clicked on its target while Sneaking
_Binds_ it to that block, ready to be used on the half of a _desk_ you want it in.
Opens its _settings_, where its action is chosen.
item.criticalmass.dashboard_switch.toolt: A switch for a _Reactor Alloy Dashboard_ that holds a receiving _Redstone Link_ on or off. Bound to a Reactor Controller it is a _protection bypass_.
When R-Clicked on its target while Sneaking
_Binds_ it to that block, ready to be used on the half of a _desk_ you want it in.
Opens its _settings_, where a glass cover can be fitted.
item.criticalmass.dashboard_lever.toolti: A lever for a _Reactor Alloy Dashboard_ that sets a receiving _Redstone Link_ to any strength from 0 to 15. Bound to a Reactor Controller it moves a _rod bank_.
When R-Clicked on its target while Sneaking
_Binds_ it to that block, ready to be used on the half of a _desk_ you want it in.
When R-Click is held on a fitted lever
Moving the mouse up or down sets its _strength_.
item.criticalmass.dashboard_gauge.toolti: A dial for a _Reactor Alloy Dashboard_ that shows one _reading_ of the plant machine it is bound to on a needle. Using it shows the number.
When R-Clicked on a plant machine while Sneaking
_Binds_ it to that machine, ready to be used on the half of a _desk_ you want it in.
When used on the side of a Pressurizer
The gauge is _fitted_ there and its dial shows the _pressure_.
item.criticalmass.dashboard_alarm.toolti: A caged lamp for a _Reactor Alloy Dashboard_. It lights for an _alarm_ on a Reactor Controller, or for _trouble_ at the electrical equipment or plant machine it is bound to.
When R-Clicked on its target while Sneaking
_Binds_ it to that block, ready to be used on the half of a _desk_ you want it in.
When a new alarm is raised
The lamp flashes and a _klaxon_ sounds until you _press the lamp_, and it then stays lit until the fault clears.
